tweets.html: BREAKING: The New York Yankees are acquiring infielder Luis García Jr. from the Washington Nationals, sources tell ESPN. Garcia, 26, leads the National League in slugging percentage and is hitting .283/.313/.560 with 23 home runs. He’s under club control through end of 2027.

tweets.html: The Houston Astros, who were swept by the Orioles coming out of the All Star break, have since gone 11-1 after sweeping the Texas Rangers They suddenly have a 2 1/2 game lead in the AL West.

tweets.author: Brian McTaggart
tweets.html: The Astros sweep the Rangers, never trailing at any point, for their season-high sixth win in a row, 7-3. They've opened up a 2 1/2-game lead in the AL West with their 11th win in their past 12 games.Astros went 9-4 vs. Texas in 2026.Trade Deadline in 24 hours, 53 minutes.
